name: Manor Mistmantle
summary: In northeastern Duskwood, Manor Mistmantle lies north of Darkshire. The old family homestead has fallen to ruin, and ghouls prowl its grounds.

sections.title: A Blighted Homestead
sections.body: West of Beggar's Haunt, decay chokes the ruined grounds of Manor Mistmantle. Vicious ghouls guard the broken house. In the untended garden, the Tear of Tilloa blooms alone, the last sign of living beauty on the estate.

sections.title: The Master of the Estate
sections.body:
Stalvan Mistmantle once taught school and served as a private tutor. Now he acts as an agent of the undead. His horrific crimes against his student's family became a dark legend across the kingdom.

Stalvan lurks on the upper floor of his family home, among the remains of those he slaughtered. Shambling horrors guard him. Travelers and investigators from Darkshire often find that the trail of Duskwood's most notorious phantom ends at this blood-soaked manor.

faq.answer: Manor Mistmantle lies in northeastern Duskwood, north of Darkshire and just west of Beggar's Haunt.
Stalvan Mistmantle owns the estate. The former tutor now exists as an undead creature, surrounded by ghouls.

faq.q: What is the Tear of Tilloa?
faq.answer: The Tear of Tilloa is a delicate flower blooming alone in Manor Mistmantle's garden. It is the only sign of natural life amid the decayed grounds.

faq.q: Why are there undead guarding the grounds?
faq.answer: Ghouls roam the manor grounds as minions bound to Stalvan Mistmantle. They guard their master and slaughter trespassers on his blighted estate.

angles.text: As an Alliance investigator tracking the grim fate of Stalvan's victims, you reach Manor Mistmantle, the tragic end of the Legend of Stalvan.
